title: Finite noninvertible permission-debt action compounds
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. Finite partial action compounds for permission with outstanding satisfaction. This adds an exact prospective writing contract to IDEA335, not a new monastic-source claim or an existing target-word gloss. Exact bounded code family and complete source-only counterexample included; no target fit or historical writing-format claim.

design.structural_link: Directed primitive composition defines each whole group as one partial semantic transformer; its action depends on entry state or typed evaluation stack. This creates exact whole-sequence interactions without a per-word sense table. It is a prospective explanation to test, not an established explanation of GDT608 whole-form residuals. Spaces delimit composition blocks and are never deleted.

writing_family.alphabet: lowercase Latin transcription characters a through z, literally; no case normalization or token deletion
writing_family.key: One injective prefix-free map from the declared semantic atom inventory to strings of length1..3. The same key is used in every complete account. No per-word/per-position key or post-target extension.
writing_family.group: Concatenation of1..3 complete atom codewords, parsed uniquely. Arbitrary grouping among those legal blocks is part of the declared finite family; no atom crosses a space.
writing_family.surface_consequences: Every group has1..9 literal characters; every character is consumed; every group is a composition of at most3 inventory atoms. These hard necessary conditions are prospective, not checked on target data. They may fail immediately.
writing_family.limits: Bounds are explicit modern model choices, not historically licensed field counts. There is no fixed total word count or universal ENTRY prefix.

design.testing: First source-only exhaustive bounded programs and deliberately wrong-semantics controls; then a separately registered complete-target capacity/fit test only if selected. A syntactically valid parse alone is not semantic evidence. No target test is selected here.
design.failures: GDT885 rules out its fixed reversible common-endpoint three-state class; these are fixed noninvertible partial maps or typed queries, not that class. GDT903 unrestricted automaton compatibility cannot justify either fixed semantic inventory. GDT616 original contract remains failed. R1/R2 and GDT969 remain closed; no alphabet/width/bound repair after an outcome. GDT949 semantic-discriminator stop is retained from parent notification, not claimed independently read in this bounded draft.
design.access: No raw target input, target image, reserve, new admission or contact. Existing source ownership and predecessor metadata/reports only.
design.mechanism: Finite partial action compounds for permission with outstanding satisfaction. This adds an exact prospective writing contract to IDEA335, not a new monastic-source claim or an existing target-word gloss.
design.source: Owned IDEA335 source: Rule of Benedict43, https://archive.osb.org/rb/text/rbemjo2.html; early medieval work through modern English translation. The previously owned card was read in full. No fresh source download or complete-chapter verification is claimed.
design.semantic_projection: Complete finite event accounts about late arrival, permission, satisfaction and observable participation/debt status. Not a translation of the full chapter or its explanatory prose. One actor per account; no free actor reset inside it.
design.program: A whole account starts A, has1..24 atoms, contains L, ends OA in state A, and has at least one action. Every partial transition must be defined. For a joint contrast packet require both an account containing P and a distinct account without P. Neither the number of accounts nor a source event count licenses a target paragraph match.
design.different_rival: Permission cancels debt: replace P(B)=C with P(B)=A, leave all other operations fixed. The full permission account fails at OC (and subsequently S), although opening/closing participation is the same. Merely recognizing an isolated P or a repeated endpoint cannot satisfy both source accounts.
design.noncommutation: L then P maps A to C; P then L is undefined at A. S is not an inverse of permission. One global code must preserve this difference across group boundaries.
design.needed_data: A finite whole-account ownership hypothesis; all literal group boundaries; a nominated pair of complete accounts and a independently constrained debt/permission consequence or a declared joint reading. No existing target word is assigned. Source history alone does not supply target binding.
design.closest_predecessors: IDEA335 is the owned content parent. IDEA79 already discusses idempotence; this card does not claim that idea anew. GDT885/903 primary reports read during preceding bounded source turn. GDT949 not yet independently reviewed; selection remains forbidden until exact primary review.
design.novelty_limit: New finite partial-map/space-preserving code family, not new evidence for institutional content. It could be retained as a child of335; no reopening conclusion.
